task_description: Fix the PJUD bot search flow that fails when clicking Buscar (returns 0 results and resets). The root cause is incorrect dropdown selection order and interaction pattern. Also fix 8 additional stability issues: BOT_MODE/BOT_MAX_CAUSAS env vars not read, hardcoded 10-detail limit, page.goBack() losing session, hardcoded years, screenshot paths, markCausaScraped never called, CHECK constraint violation on tipo field, and dead code.
